description:
Private offline flight logbook for aviation enthusiasts

Flybook is a private, offline flight logbook for Android. Your logbook lives entirely on your device — no account, no cloud, no tracking.

Features:

  • Log flights with date, flight number, airline, departure and arrival airports, aircraft, registration, seat, cabin class, times, distance, and notes
  • Smart auto-enrichment: enter airport IATA/ICAO codes and an airline, and Flybook fills in names, cities, countries, aircraft types, great-circle distance, and estimated duration from bundled reference data
  • Dashboard with at-a-glance stats: flights, distance, time in air, airlines, countries, and airports, plus a monthly activity chart and unlockable achievements
  • Your Flight Story: a wrapped-style review of your flying history
  • 3D globe: every route drawn as a great-circle arc on an interactive, fully offline globe — spin, zoom and tap airports for details
  • Optional 2D flight map with multiple base styles, geodesic route lines, and color customization
  • Stats and rankings: most-flown aircraft, airlines, routes, airports, tail registrations, seats, and countries
  • Import and export your logbook as CSV or JSON, including my.flightradar24.com export format
  • Fully offline: the 3D globe works without any network; the only network access is fetching tiles when you switch to the optional 2D map, from one of the bundled servers — OpenStreetMap (tile.openstreetmap.org), OpenTopoMap (tile.opentopomap.org), CARTO (basemaps.cartocdn.com), or USGS satellite imagery (basemap.nationalmap.gov)
